svg.text: ENGLISH FOR DAILY LIFE
A1 · Answer Key
Every answer, in one place.
The key to all 20 units and all 760 exercises. Each entry begins with the seeded example, so you
can see at a glance that you are reading the right exercise.
How to read it
— the example printed in the Student Book, repeated here
— separates one answer from the next
Learner's own answers
— speaking and writing tasks
Spoken
— a pronunciation task, with what to listen for
(e is not needed)
— the spare option in a matching task
Where the other answers live
Listening answers come from the audio, and every script is printed in the Audio File at the back of the
Student Book, to the word. Nothing a learner is asked for is missing from the two books together.
What is true of every page behind this one
No word is taught as new twice.
Checked across all 190 pairs of units.
Every exercise carries a worked example.
Numbered 0, and repeated in this key.
Every figure is used by an exercise.
And every exercise that needs one has one.
No answer is printed in its own figure.
A task you can copy is not a task.
The answer letters are balanced.
No learner guesses through on one letter.
Every figure was re-rendered and compared.
Byte for byte, against the file that printed.
Checked, not just written
Every exercise is keyed, every key entry is counted against its own exercise, and the example in the key is
matched against the example on the page.
